coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 5 of 11 ground-truth items (45%): FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit precision, batch size 1, prefill time, decode time, and peak memory usage.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design varies model size instead of holding the specified LLaMa-2-7B model constant, does not preserve e2e/benchmark.py methodology, sweeps sequence lengths rather than fixing prefill length at 2048, and uses 256 decode steps instead of 32. It omits explicit combined end-to-end time and computed speedup factors. Memory is estimated analytically rather than measured during execution.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the expected comparison of FP16 and QuaRot 4-bit performance.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports comparative prefill time, decode time, memory usage, or phase-specific speedup factors.
